definitions.explanation: An informal word for one's own wife, typically used by middle-aged and older men. It carries a casual, familiar tone and is used when referring to one's wife to others in relaxed conversation.

examples.japanese: {女房|にょうぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{叱|しか}られた→叱る：01202_shikaru⟧。
examples.english: I got scolded by my wife.

examples.japanese: うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{女房|にょうぼう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧だ。
examples.english: My wife is a good cook.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{連|つ}れ{添|そ}った→連れ添う：30494_tsuresou⟧{女房|にょうぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先立|さきだ}たれて、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくした。
examples.english: Having been predeceased by the wife who had been with him for so many years, he completely lost his spirits.

notes:
USAGE:
{女房|にょうぼう} is used by men to refer to their own wife in casual speech. It has a slightly old-fashioned and down-to-earth feel. Younger men tend to prefer ⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧ or ⟦{嫁|よめ}→嫁：03670_yome⟧. It is not used to refer to someone else's wife (use ⟦{奥|おく}さん→奥さん：02853_okusan⟧ instead).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{女房|にょうぼう}: my wife (casual)
- {女房|にょうぼう}{役|やく}: a supportive partner/right-hand person
- {恐妻家|きょうさいか}: henpecked husband (related concept)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧ is the neutral, standard term. ⟦{嫁|よめ}→嫁：03670_yome⟧ is colloquial and common among younger speakers. ⟦{家内|かない}→家内：00958_kanai⟧ is polite but somewhat dated. {女房|にょうぼう} has the most casual, unpretentious tone among these.

ETYMOLOGY:
Originally referred to ladies-in-waiting at the imperial court ({女房|にょうぼう} literally means "woman's room/quarters"). The meaning shifted to "wife" during the Edo period.
